units.title: Dormant operator session and policy seam
units.behavior: Add CampaignOperatorCredential from operator environment or protected data-dir file (0600 on POSIX; restrictive user ACL on Windows). POST /api/campaign-local-session consumes proof and issues a bounded HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie; Secure on HTTPS, explicit Origin/CSRF validation and no proxy-header authority. resolveActor/authorize live in campaignAccess.ts; valid self-issued bearer proves identity only. Electron passes the secret to its child and establishes the cookie with session.cookies before loadURL; no renderer IPC secret and no account/seat requirement. Development prints a secret-free local pairing link once; prove the secret in a POST, never URLs/responses/logs. No campaign route enforcement yet; dormant seam does not break callers.
regressionTests: offline Electron create/save/reload and cookie renewal after restart
real secret proof, Origin/CSRF, replay/expiry and self-issued stranger refusal
